title: Mausoleum Key
body:
"a key meant for the hidden secrets down bellow"


The Mausoleum Key says it opens the gate in the basement of the Monstrous Manor , it can be found on the second floor of the shed behind the mansion, to reach this spot there are planks leaning out of a hole in the back, a gravity coil is recommended

when the gate is open a Broken Fence will spawn in the coffin
